content: Dart Timer.periodic is not a precise clock -- callback firing drifts under load (widget rebuilds, GC, other timers) and short periods (e.g. 20ms) can drift into 100-1000ms range. For a countdown, do not decrement a counter each tick; instead compute remaining = endTime.difference(DateTime.now()) against a captured start wall-clock time so the displayed value self-corrects for drift. Keep tick work trivial (setState displaying a value only) to avoid frame budget (~16ms) overruns and jank; never do I/O or heavy compute inside the timer callback or build method.
